convert_pump_source: convert a .pump source file into generated C++ boilerplate code
run_pump_cli: run pump.py as a CLI tool to transform a .pump file to its output file
tokenize_pump_text: tokenize Pump source text into a stream of lexical tokens
parse_pump_to_ast: parse Pump source text into an abstract syntax tree for code generation
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters
